testSmells.title: Improper Organization
testSmells.message:
It does not have a Proper Organization.

Tests should have the following structure:

- Arrange: This is where you initialize objects and set the value of the data to be passed to the function under test.

- Act: The act section invokes the function under test.

- Assert: This is where you verify that the action of the function under test behaves as expected.

So asserts should be together at the end of the test.

mentorFindings.name: Move helper method to the right class
mentorFindings.title: Move helper method to the right class: SurveyCrawlerTest>>crawlerFacingUpWith:at:
mentorFindings.detail: The method SurveyCrawlerTest>>crawlerFacingUpWith:at: does not follow the heuristic: A method referencing no self, super nor instance variable is a helper: it belongs on the class of one of its parameters, as an extension method when that class is in another package.
